output_list.criticism: The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function allows the owner to mint a new token and transfer it to any user input address, causing a integer overflow in the ownership token count mapping, making the balance of a target user to be a large arbitrary value.

The mintBatch function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function allows the owner to mint a batch of new tokens and transfer them to any user input addresses, causing a integer overflow in the ownership token count mapping, making the balance of a target user to be a large arbitrary value.
